person: Jolene Haverkamp, corn and soybean farmer who runs the Haverkamp Farm Shop and coaches the Corwin Grove Kestrels 12U youth baseball team, near Corwin Grove, Iowa

mail.subject: Your 2027 seed order – early-pay discount
mail.body: Hi Jolene, I've drafted your 2027 order: 60 bags of HS-4410 corn and 42 units of Ridgeline 2.8 soybeans. The list total is $18,400. If it's paid within 20 days you get our 6% early-pay discount. Can we go over the north field hybrid on a call sometime next week? – Priya

mail.subject: Banquet a week from today – what to bring
mail.body: Coaches, the end-of-season banquet is a week from today at the Legion Hall, doors open at 1:30. Each coach please bring a side dish and your team's trophies. Parents were asked to chip in $8 per player for trophies; for the Kestrels' 12 players that's $96. Please collect it and hand it to me at the banquet. – Ray

mail.subject: Christmas tree shipment scheduled
mail.body: Hi Jolene, your 120 Fraser firs ($31 each) and 60 balsam firs ($24 each) will come on our truck the Tuesday before Thanksgiving, in the morning. The invoice total is $5,160, payable within 30 days of delivery. The driver will need a forklift or three people to unload. – Ingrid, Northwind Tree Farm

mail.subject: 2027 rule changes for youth coaches
mail.body: New for 2027: 12U pitchers may throw at most 85 pitches per day, with 4 days of rest after 66 or more. Bats must carry the new BPF 1.10 stamp. Coach certification renewal opens next month; the fee is $20.

mail.subject: Registration confirmed – badge PF-2291
mail.body: Thanks for registering, Jolene. Your badge number is PF-2291 and your $295 registration is paid. The conference starts three weeks from tomorrow at the Ridgeport Convention Center. Badge pickup opens at 7:00am that first morning in the main lobby, and the opening keynote is at 8:15. Our room block at the Ridgeport Lantern Inn is $129 a night and closes 12 days from today; book with group code PFRC26.

mail.subject: November indoor rental – Kestrels 12U
mail.body: Invoice PFH-1107 for November: 4 Tuesday sessions at $45 each, total $180, due at the end of the month. Pay at the front desk or by check made out to Pellston Field House.

mail.subject: Your November bill is ready
mail.body: Account 7720-1184. Amount due: $312.40, due in 10 days. Your usage is up 22% on last month, mostly the grain dryer. Autopay is not set up on this account.

mail.subject: Your applicator certification is expiring
mail.body: Your private pesticide applicator certification, number PA-55190, expires in 45 days. To renew, pay the $15 fee and complete either a 2-hour in-person recertification session or the online module. In-person sessions run at the Marlow County Extension Office on the first Tuesday of each month.

mail.subject: Winter rabbit show – exhibitor info
mail.body: Exhibitors: the winter rabbit show is the Sunday after Thanksgiving at the Marlow County Fairgrounds, Small Animal Barn. Check-in is 9:00–9:45 and judging starts at 10. The entry fee is $4 per rabbit, cash at check-in. Every rabbit needs its own carrier or cage. Junior showmanship starts after lunch.

mail.subject: Combine service booked
mail.body: Hi Jolene, your Ridgeway 8250 combine is booked for its post-harvest service next Thursday morning. The estimate is $1,240 for parts and labour (concaves, belts, fluids). If you'd like us to haul it in, pickup is $150. – Gunnar, Halvorsen Implement

mail.subject: Thanksgiving break
mail.body: Reminder to families: there is no school Wednesday through Friday of Thanksgiving week. Classes resume the following Monday. There is early dismissal at 1:15 on the Tuesday before break.

mail.subject: Lucia's trophy money
mail.body: Hi Coach Jolene, I just sent Lucia's $8 for the trophy through PayTrail. Sorry it's late! – Gabi

mail.subject: Turkeys ready next Wednesday
mail.body: Jolene, your 38 fresh turkeys will be ready for pickup next Wednesday morning. They're averaging 22 lb at $2.00 a pound, so the balance is $1,672, payable when you collect. Bring the cooler trailer. – Pieter

mail.subject: Your crop insurance review
mail.body: Hi Jolene, I've set your annual review for the Monday after Thanksgiving at our Fenwick office. Please bring your yield records for 2024 through 2026. My premium estimate for 2027 revenue protection at 80% coverage is $9,860, up from $9,120 this year. – Rosalind

mail.subject: Weekly eggs for Linden Street Kitchen?
mail.body: Hi Jolene, we loved your eggs at the market. Could you supply 15 dozen a week starting the first week of December? What would you charge per dozen, and could you deliver on Tuesdays before 10am?

mail.subject: Thanksgiving at ours
mail.body: Hi hon! Thanksgiving's at our place again. Come at 1 and we'll eat at 2. Could you bring 3 pumpkin pies and some of the folding chairs from the shop? Hollis is smoking the turkey this year. Cody can bring the rabbit if he must, ha. Love, Bev

mail.subject: New pie preorder P-1042
mail.body: Customer: Keisha Broussard. 1 pecan pie, 1 sweet potato pie. Pickup: Pie Pickup Day, Saturday next week. Paid online: $46.00.

mail.subject: Wednesday delivery + invoice
mail.body: Hi Jolene, your holiday order arrives Wednesday afternoon: 20 gallons of eggnog, 40 quarts of heavy cream and 30 lb of butter. Invoice BWD-3318 for $486.20 is due 15 days after delivery. – Tariq, Brightwater Dairy

mail.subject: Spring travel tryouts
mail.body: Coaches, spring travel tryouts are the Saturday after Thanksgiving at Pellston. We're expecting about 46 kids for 24 spots across two teams. Please send the sign-up link to your parents by this coming Sunday evening. Evaluators, bring a clipboard and a stopwatch. – Ray

mail.subject: Scale ticket 44817
mail.body: Delivered 07:22. Soybeans, net 1,012 bushels, moisture 11.8%, no dockage. Cash price $10.12/bu. Settlement of $10,241.44 will be deposited within 3 business days.

mail.subject: Pitching mechanics clinic Sunday
mail.body: Hi coaches, the pitching mechanics clinic is this Sunday at Pellston Field House. It's $25 per coach, cash at the door. Bring a glove and a notebook; we'll cover arm care and the new pitch limits. – Imani

mail.subject: Thursday board meeting – agenda
mail.body: Hi all, agenda for Thursday's board meeting: 1) spring registration fees, 2) field lights fundraiser, 3) tryout logistics. Jolene, could you bring the Kestrels' equipment inventory? Coffee and bars provided. – Lupe

mail.subject: Your order has shipped
mail.body: Order FL-88302: 6 dozen dimpled practice balls, $71.94. Arriving Thursday. Tracking number 1FL7720934.

mail.subject: Conference on Friday
mail.body: Hi Ms. Haverkamp, I'm looking forward to meeting on Friday in Room 112. Cody is doing really well in science, but he has 3 missing math assignments I'd like to talk through. – Ms. Adeyemi

mail.subject: Day off?
mail.body: Hey Jolene, could I have the Friday after Thanksgiving off? My cousin's wedding is that weekend. I can still work the turkey pickup Wednesday and all of pie day this Saturday. Thanks! – Dakota

mail.subject: Upcoming loan payment
mail.body: Your operating loan payment of $4,215.00 will be drafted from your farm checking account in 6 days.

mail.subject: Documents before Monday
mail.body: Hi Jolene, ahead of our meeting next Monday, please send a current balance sheet and your last two years of tax returns by this Friday. Bring photo ID on the day. We're on the 2nd floor of the Marlow office; enter from the back lot.

mail.subject: Our call tomorrow
mail.body: Confirming our call tomorrow. I'll ring your cell. I'd like to talk about switching the north field to HS-4380; it's $14 less per bag.

mail.subject: Preg check booked
mail.body: Hi Jolene, the preg check for your 34 cows is booked for two weeks from today. The fee is $6 a head plus an $85 farm call. Please have them penned in the east barn before I arrive.

mail.subject: Appointment reminder
mail.body: This is a reminder that your cleaning with Dr. Achterberg is this Friday. Please arrive 10 minutes early. Your copay is $35.

mail.subject: Hay Saturday?
mail.body: Jolene, can you drop 40 small squares at our place Saturday morning? I'll pay $6 a bale cash. Cody's welcome to borrow our rabbit cage for the show; swing by for it any day next week. – Lars

mail.subject: Next Tuesday
mail.body: Coach, my shift changed and I can't make next Tuesday's hitting session. Can someone else run the pitching machine? I'll be back the week after.

mail.subject: Turkey pickup list
mail.body: 38 turkey orders for Wednesday's customer pickup. 31 are paid in full and 7 paid a $20 deposit only.

mail.subject: Pie pickup time
mail.body: Hi, I preordered 2 pecan pies and 1 apple for Saturday. Could I pick them up at 4 instead of noon? Order P-1019. Thanks, Arjun

mail.subject: Pie preorder summary
mail.body: Pie preorders for Saturday: 64 pies in total – 26 pumpkin, 20 pecan, 12 apple and 6 sweet potato. 9 orders are still unpaid.

mail.subject: Wednesday grain report
mail.body: Cash corn $4.02 and soybeans $10.18 at Fenwick Co-op this morning. Snow likely Friday night, 2–4 inches.

mail.subject: Parts in – and our new address
mail.body: Morning Jolene, the parts for your combine are in, so we'll see you tomorrow. Heads up: we've moved into the new building at 1840 Industrial Parkway in Fenwick, just past the co-op.

mail.subject: Emre and tryouts
mail.body: Hi Coach, Emre has a wrestling tournament on the Saturday after Thanksgiving. Is there any way he can try out late or on another day? – Yusuf

mail.subject: A tree for the church?
mail.body: Hi Jolene, could we buy a 9-foot Fraser fir for the sanctuary again this year, delivered the first Saturday in December? Last year it was $85 with delivery.

mail.subject: Chairs
mail.body: Forgot to say, we'll need 8 of the folding chairs. Hollis says hi!

reminders.title: Call Halvorsen to confirm combine service
Put Christmas tree prices on the sign
Collect trophy money from Kestrels parents
Send tryout sign-up link to parents
Buy catcher's gear for team bag
Pick up rabbit cage from Ostergaards
Send balance sheet and tax returns to FSA
